neighbours.label: The token that opens a line of literal example values or commands in documentation or a config block (' ``' before a quoted option, '>' before a command, the indent before a dict string); the same blocks with numbers or plain prose stay quiet.
fire:
Parameters
----------
mode : str
    The mode. Can be ``'fast'``,
    ``'slow'`` or ``'auto'``.
Examples:
> mytool-cli getinfo 20
> curl http://localhost:8332
settings = {
    'title': 'home',
    'theme': 'dark',
    'lang': 'en',
}
Options
-------
kind : str
    One of ``'a'``,
    ``'x'`` or ``'y'``.
Usage:
> foo-cli listblocks 5
> foo-cli status
params = {
    'user': 'bob',
    'role': 'admin',
    'city': 'Oslo',
}
Returns
-------
status : str
    Either ``'ok'``,
    ``'bad'`` or ``'none'``.
Commands:
> db-cli getkey 9
> db-cli setkey 9

notes: A low-confidence reading. The output direction promotes string openers (' "', '("', '\'). One-line code and most assignments stayed low in probes ('_PROJECT_ID = "PD"' 0.02), so the top examples' ' =' and '.get' are not covered.
